departments.title: The Entrance
departments.sub: The hall, five tracks, one screen each
departments.body: One hall. Five large screens around you, one for every track. Tap a screen: the film plays, the summary sits beside it, the features sit below.

hotspots.title: AI Embedding for Businesses
hotspots.abstract: We don't install and leave, we embed. In the business, and with its customers. We start by mapping how the business actually works, and only then build: AI agents, automations, websites and systems, video and advertising, everything that grows a business, fully owned by it.

features.title: Business mapping before code
features.text: Questions before solutions. The map of the business's processes is the first document.

features.title: AI agents and automations
features.text: Work that repeats moves to an agent, messages, follow-ups, summaries.

features.text: From a landing page to a full system with users and payments.

features.text: A product clip, an ad, or a film for an event, AI-based production end to end.

features.title: Measured on the bottom line
features.text: Every deployment is defined by a number: time saved, inquiries answered, sales closed.

hotspots.title: Measurement Solutions
hotspots.sub: LiDAR · Depth · Stair · Pit · Slope · Mesh
hotspots.abstract: Engineering-grade measurement from a LiDAR scan. No tape measure, no estimate, a number. The depth of a surface, the height of a stair, the volume of a pit, the slope of a ramp, and a 3D model that goes straight to the printer. Real projects were delivered on these features.

features.title: Depth
features.text: A depth map of any surface, at millimeter resolution.

features.title: Stair measurement
features.text: Height and width of every stair in a flight, automatically, from one scan.

features.title: Pit measurement
features.text: Volume and depth of a pit or an excavation, without climbing into it.

features.title: Slope measurement
features.text: The slope of a ramp or a surface, in percent and in degrees.

features.title: The Mesh world
features.text: A 3D scan that exports as a file for 3D printing, at the resolution you set.

features.title: Proof: CoreInspect
features.text: An engineering home inspection built on these features.

hotspots.abstract: We turn any dumb camera into a smart one, to your spec. This is a product, not a workshop: the camera already on your wall gains a new capability, and the alert lands on your phone.

features.title: Door open / closed

features.title: Suspicious entry

features.title: People counting

features.title: Fall detection

hotspots.title: AR
hotspots.abstract: AR here is not a promise, it is a shop you can already walk through. A complete virtual supermarket: 13 departments, a real catalogue, a cart that travels with you, search that brings the product to you, and an assistant that builds a whole basket for an event from one sentence. The site you are standing in is the next step, and information layers over real spaces are on the way.

hotspots.title: Who we are
hotspots.sub: Two founders who do the work themselves
hotspots.abstract: Ariel and Lidor. One builds, one leads, both are inside every project. No outsourcing, no layers. Everything you see on this site, including the site itself, was built by their hands.

people.name: Ariel Ohayon
people.text: Runs the Claude Israel community, 18K members. Speaks on the AI shift at conferences and inside organisations, and builds AI products. BA in economics and business administration. Everything that works in the field, he brings to your project.

people.name: Lidor Dahan
people.text: PhD in electrical and computer engineering. About six years developing AI for autonomous vehicles, and founded ventures in computer vision and smart cities. From the problem, to a prototype, to a product that runs.

hotspots.title: The embedding promise
hotspots.text: Corewise doesn't install and leave, we embed: in the business, and with its customers. I promise you will use this, and love it. That's the power.
